repos_data.description: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI. Web app, desktop app, and an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code.
Cloud architecture diagrams in both directions: AI prompt or JSON to diagram, diagram to Terraform via MCP server, and Terraform to diagram via CLI or CI/CD. Using Official AWS, Azure and GCP icons.

Understand any codebase in 60 seconds - an MCP server, CLI and GitHub Action that turns any repo into an architecture diagram (Mermaid/Graphviz) and enforces architecture rules in CI. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client.
